answer: Sequential task-novelty chain: each new agent identity must solve a fresh, verifiable task drawn from a shared queue, and the solution is checked at falcon speed by prior agents before the identity goes live. A cheater can copy answers, so the system scores solutions by novelty against the last thousand accepted outputs; duplicates earn nothing. Reaching the seasonal zenith of throughput requires maintaining distinct, non-redundant work, and the saffron-tier review pool audits random submissions.
